class.name: IfcRectangleProfileDef
class.brief_description: IfcRectangleProfileDef defines a rectangle as the profile definition used by the swept surface geometry or the swept area solid. It is given by its X extent and its Y extent, and placed within the 2D position coordinate system, established by the Position attribute. It is placed centric within the position coordinate system. HISTORY: New class in IFC 1.5. The use definition has changed in IFC Rele

members.member: The extent of the rectangle in the direction of the x-axis.
The extent of the rectangle in the direction of the y-axis.
